exercises.question: Which sentence uses an impersonal se construction? [¿Cuál usa una construcción impersonal con se?]
options: Se publican nuevas leyes cada año. [New laws are published every year.]
El Parlamento publicó una ley. [Parliament published a law.]
El Gobierno decide. [The government decides.]

exercises.sentence: __ publican nuevas leyes cada año. (se) [New laws are published every year.]

exercises.english: Public services are offered in the city.

sentences: Se publican nuevas leyes cada año. [New laws are published every year.]
Se ofrecen servicios públicos en la ciudad. [Public services are offered in the city.]
Se toman decisiones importantes en estas reuniones. [Important decisions are made in these meetings.]

exercises.question: Which sentence focuses on a completed passive action? [¿Cuál se centra en una acción pasiva completada?]
options: La ley fue aprobada por el Parlamento. [The law was approved by Parliament.]
Se publica una ley. [A law is published.]
Se toman decisiones. [Decisions are made.]

exercises.sentence: La ley fue __ por el Parlamento. (aprobar) [The law was approved by Parliament.]
